# Structured Decisions

[简体中文](../../../../learning/paths/system-one/index.md) · English

Use language models for decisions over finite candidates: start with distribution readout, then test invariance, reasoning budgets, and ongoing feedback.

Choose a subtopic and start with its paper questions.
